rules.name: not-session-owner
rules.message: this session belongs to a different principal
rules.hint: Open your own session. Session ids are not transferable.

rules.name: tripwire
rules.message: this capability is never exposed to any agent
rules.hint: There is no way to do this through Clearance. Ask a human. This attempt has tripped the session breaker.

rules.name: unknown-tool
rules.message: unknown tool
rules.hint: List the available tools with tools/list.

rules.name: session-expired
rules.message: the session has ended
rules.hint: Open a new session.

rules.name: breaker-tripped
rules.message: the session breaker is tripped
rules.hint: A human must review this session; open a new one after review.

rules.name: tool-not-permitted
rules.message: tool is not permitted for this session
rules.hint: Use a tool in your definition, or ask for the definition to be changed by a reviewed commit.

rules.name: above-ceiling
rules.message: tool tier is above this session's ceiling
rules.hint: Propose the change as a PR for a human to merge instead.

rules.name: bad-arguments
rules.message: required arguments are missing
rules.hint: Supply every required argument; see the tool schema.

rules.name: tool-calls-exhausted
rules.message: tool-call budget is spent
rules.hint: Stop and report progress; do not retry.

rules.name: github-budget
rules.message: GitHub API budget would be exceeded
rules.hint: Batch changes into fewer calls, or stop and report.

rules.name: pr-budget
rules.message: open-PR budget is spent
rules.hint: Update an existing PR instead of opening another.

rules.name: wrong-environment
rules.message: this tool acts on lower environments only, but the target is an upper environment
rules.hint: Use repo.pr.open_upper to propose the change; a human merge applies it.

rules.name: upper-must-propose
rules.message: T2 tools may only propose
rules.hint: This tool cannot apply changes to an upper environment.

rules.name: repo-not-allowed
rules.message: repository is not on this agent's allowlist
rules.hint: Work only in repositories your definition names.

rules.name: path-not-allowed
rules.message: the change touches a protected path
rules.hint: Remove the protected paths from the change; agents cannot edit their own controls.

rules.name: spawn-refused
rules.message: a spawn was refused (raised by the handler: depth or children budget)
rules.hint: Spawn fewer or smaller child runs, or finish the ones running.

rules.name: api-not-allowed
rules.message: that application API is not on this agent's allowlist
rules.hint: Call only the services your definition names under profile.apis.allow.

rules.name: artifact-too-large
rules.message: the artifact is larger than 1 MiB
rules.hint: Store a smaller summary; artifacts are outputs, not datasets.

rules.name: chat-outside-session
rules.message: chat tools exist only for session agents
rules.hint: Only an interactive session agent has a human on the other end.

rules.name: field-not-allowed
rules.message: the change touches a field this agent may not set
rules.hint: Remove that field from the change and let a human or the release pipeline set it instead.

tools.name: catalog.read
tools.description: Search the Backstage catalog. `query` with `=` is a Backstage filter, comma-separated fields that must all match (kind=component,spec.type=service; kind=component,spec.owner=group:default/<team>; kind=system); without `=` it is a full-text search of entity names, titles and descriptions. Apps and services are kind=component

tools.name: app.api.get
tools.description: GET a path on an allowlisted application API

tools.name: chat.recv
tools.description: Receive pending messages from the human in this session

tools.name: chat.send
tools.description: Send a message to the human in this session

tools.name: repo.file.get
tools.description: Read a file, or list a directory (path empty: the repo root), in an allowed repo at a ref (default main)

tools.name: repo.pr.open
tools.description: Open a PR on an app repo

tools.name: xr.request
tools.description: Commit an XR request for a lower environment

tools.name: artifact.put
tools.description: Store an output artifact under this task (bounded, expiring)

tools.name: artifact.get
tools.description: Read an artifact stored under this task tree

tools.name: run.spawn
tools.description: Start a child agent run, narrower than this one

tools.name: run.close
tools.description: Close one of this session's own runs

tools.name: human.request
tools.description: Ask a person a question (non-blocking: returns its id at once)

tools.name: human.request.get
tools.description: Read one of this task's human requests: pending, answered (with the answer) or expired

tools.name: repo.pr.open_upper
tools.description: Open a PR against an upper environment (a human merges)
